# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **Mask filtered glyph fixes**

## Highlights

The unreleased 4.157.0 changes correct mask-filtered glyph rendering when successive font-scaler loads return different glyph data.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Mask-filtered glyph rendering corrected** — When consecutive font-scaler loads disagree about a glyph's path, format, or bounds, rendering now uses the reloaded glyph and clears incompatible masks instead of copying them. This avoids stale outlines, format assertions, and sub-byte buffer overwrites; clipped embossed glyphs also retain correct data across all three mask planes. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
